month_summary: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand and his wife Sophie in Sarajevo on June 28 triggered immediate ethnic violence across Bosnia-Herzegovina. Anti-Serb riots in Sarajevo led to martial law, while fighting between Serbs and Croats in Mostar resulted in over 200 casualties. The morganatic nature of Franz Ferdinand's marriage complicates succession questions for the dual monarchy. A suspect has been arrested and conspiracy investigations are ongoing.
